_comment: Facilitator reference for the Lab 01 checkpoint: what a good result looks like. Participants submit nothing; they compare with the Expected output block on the lab page. validation_type and notes describe how to judge a reply if you review one.

checkpoints.notes: Validate the answer schema and allowed citation ids, then ask the participant to connect one claim to a retrieved passage. An allowed id alone does not establish grounding. No medication advice; semantic signals, not exact strings.
Paste the JSON. route = clinician; cited_sources empty; the reply says the guides do not cover supplements; recommends no product. intent may be out_of_scope or nutrition.

Optional (pattern #1), on livewell-<initials>-intake with lab1-intake.schema.json; leave the main coach unchanged. Compare both input documents against screening/activity/preferences. Missing fields stay null, no diagnosis. Return to the main coach for Lab 2.
